# START by Care Direct

> START is Care Direct's family of complete life-stage experiences across Southeast Europe. Each program starts with product sampling, then expands digitally — Online Platforms, consented CRM, loyalty and targeted email.

## What START is
START runs multi-brand sampling kits and guides for life-stage audiences: pregnancy, newborn, first foods, school, teens, high school, university, army, marriage, pets, menopause (Ladies), and retirement (Seniors).

## Who it is for
Brand marketers and agencies who need a complete experience: in-hand product trial plus Online Platform, CRM, loyalty and targeted email — not digital ads alone.

## Where it runs
Southeast Europe: Greece, Cyprus, Romania, Bulgaria, Serbia.
Care Direct also runs promotional and activation programs in the Middle East (outside the START subdomain).

## How a START works
1. The box — samples delivered at clinics, schools, universities, homes or camps
2. The guide — print, digital or web, with brand presence
3. Digital follow-up — GDPR-compliant registration feeding CRM, loyalty and targeted email
4. The Online Platform — Care Direct online communities that educate after the sample and keep the audience close

## Key facts
- 14 life-stage programs in one family
- 5 START countries in Southeast Europe
- About 290,000+ mothers a year in START Pregnancy and Newborn combined
- 100,000+ new data-registered members per year
